# immich_server_statistics (Data Source)

Retrieve all media types supported by the Immich server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "immich_server_statistics" "statistics" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `photos` (Number) Total number of photos.
- `usage` (Number) Total storage usage in bytes.
- `usage_by_user` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--usage_by_user))
- `usage_photos` (Number) Storage usage for photos in bytes.
- `usage_videos` (Number) Storage usage for videos in bytes.
- `videos` (Number) Total number of videos.

<a id="nestedatt--usage_by_user"></a>
### Nested Schema for `usage_by_user`

Read-Only:

- `photos` (Number) Number of photos.
- `quota_size_in_bytes` (Number) User quota size in bytes.
- `usage` (Number) Total storage usage in bytes.
- `usage_photos` (Number) Storage usage for photos in bytes.
- `usage_videos` (Number) Storage usage for videos in bytes.
- `user_id` (String) User Id.
- `user_name` (String) User name.
- `videos` (Number) Number of videos.
